revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - lin1 (καθοσιώμ(ενος)) => <:καθωσιωμένος|reg|(καθοσιωμ(ένος)):> ; ἀγανακτήσειν => <:ἀγανάκτησιν|reg|ἀγανάκτησειν:>. Check AnalPap 27 (2015)137 in case there's anything else to incorporate.
Submit - Added Korr. Tyche 786: In Z. 1 ist unter dem υ des ὑμ[...] eine Unterpunktierung zu ergänzen (sowohl im Text als auch im Apparat)

Finalized - Ready. The text commited here represents the text of the original edition. I think that the interpretation offered by L. Berkes when he submitted the text is good. It would, however, be better to submit that as a separate correction, thus preserving the stages of the understanding of the text.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - add the reg in lin1

Submit - Text from ed. pr. I didn't manage to add the diaeresis at the end of line 1. Line seems to be misunderstood: hypo aganakthsein (l. aganakthsin) ths hy[meteras] 2. megalopr(epeias) genomenos seems to be a more natural reading.
